title: Canonical interior stalk comparison for the abelian extension presheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $U$ an open subset, $x\in U$, and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $U$. Let $P=j_{p!}G$ be the direct-sum extension presheaf [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero], with stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There is an isomorphism $e:G_x\simeq P_x$ such that for every open $V\subseteq U$ containing $x$, the germ map $G(V)\to G_x$ followed by $e$ is the injection of the unique summand indexed by $V\to U$ into $P(V)$ followed by its germ map to $P_x$. No sheafification, outside-stalk assertion, morphism naturality or counit assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: Definition 00A4; Lemma 00A5(3), (4); proof omitted in Stacks, supplied by T1 using Mathlib restriction-stalk comparison

proof.text: On opens W of U, take V to be the open image of W in X. The inverse-image/open-image composite is naturally isomorphic to the identity, by Opens.map_functor_eq and thinness of the category of opens. Precomposing G with this comparison gives a presheaf Q naturally isomorphic to G. Inject Q(W) into the summand of P(V) indexed by V into U. This is natural: siteExtensionByZeroRestrict evaluated on the injection is the injection indexed by the composite inclusion, followed by the same restriction of G. The two inclusions into U are equal by thinness.

For every W, inclusions V into U form a Unique type. The component of the preceding natural transformation is therefore the inverse of DirectSum.id, the canonical sum-over-a-single-index equivalence. Thus all components are isomorphisms and NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app gives a presheaf isomorphism G to the restriction of P.

Apply stalkFunctor.mapIso to this presheaf isomorphism and compose with PresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso. The latter follows from Final.colimitIso for the opposite of the open-image neighborhood functor, which is initial by its adjunction with inverse image. Its germ formula is restrictStalkIso_hom_eq_germ. For V contained in U, open image of inverse image equals V. Combining this with stalkFunctor_map_germ and transporting along that equality computes the composite as the specified injection followed by the germ.

lean.statement: theorem abelianOpenExtensionPresheaf_stalk (X : TopCat.{w}) (U : Opens X) (x : U) (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{w} ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) : ∃ e : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk G.obj x ≅ TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((abelianOpenExtensionPresheaf U).obj G) x.val, ∀ (V : Opens X) (hV : V ≤ U) (hx : x.val ∈ V), TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.obj ((Opens.map U.inclusion').obj V) x hx ≫ e.hom = AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (DirectSum.of (fun φ : V ⟶ U ↦ (openSlicePresheaf U G.obj).obj (op (Over.mk φ))) (homOfLE hV)) ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((abelianOpenExtensionPresheaf U).obj G) V x.val hx
